title: RPHA 91

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The HJC RPHA 91 delivers one-handed chin bar actuation paired with certified dual-homologation protection, delivering flip-up versatility for city stops and sealed protection at speed. Built around a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell weighing 1649g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~89 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across DOT, ECE 22.06 benchmarks. Inside, 3D laser-cut cheek pads tailor naturally to an Intermediate Oval profile with dedicated eyewear relief channels, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for confident all-day riding.

product_details.description: Functional modular helmet with P/J homologation.

variants.title: HJC RPHA 91 Matte Black
variants.description: The HJC RPHA 91 is a benchmark Modular helmet crafted in South Korea 🇰🇷. Built around Premium Integrated Matrix (P.I.M. Plus) carbon and carbon-glass hybrid fabric shell structure, it is engineered specifically for Intermediate Oval ergonomics. Engineered for highway touring flexibility, featuring a dual P/J homologated flip-up chinbar, one-handed latch mechanism, and integrated sun visor. Global racing technology engineered for maximum ventilation efficiency.

product_details.description: Functional modular helmet with P/J homologation.

variants.introduction: Positioned in HJC's Modular lineup, the RPHA 91 brings South Korean engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.06 track safety.
variants.story:
The HJC RPHA 91 represents HJC's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~89 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Modular helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the HJC RPHA 91 delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
variants.finish_profile: HJC RPHA 91 Matte Black (matte finish) — Treated with a mirror-finish deep gloss clearcoat that repels road grime and simplifies bug cleanup.
variants.editorial_note: HJC RPHA 91 in HJC RPHA 91 Matte Black. A dependable modular workhorse engineered for straightforward daily commuting and weekend touring flexibility.
variants.fitment_notes: Optimized for Intermediate Oval head shapes with temple pressure-relief grooves for eyewear. 3D contoured cheek pads experience a 12-15 riding hour break-in period, relaxing by ~15% for facial fitment.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for oval head shapes; may feel tight on intermediate oval heads.

technical_analysis: Features Premium Integrated Matrix (P.I.M. Plus) carbon and carbon-glass hybrid fabric shell structure paired with RapidFire II visor replacement system with 2D flat race shield and dual locking mechanism. The interior utilizes ACS Advanced Channeling Ventilation System with Multicool anti-bacterial temperature-regulating interior with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the HJC RPHA 91: combining South Korea 🇰🇷 craftsmanship with RapidFire II visor replacement system with 2D flat race shield and dual locking mechanism and ACS Advanced Channeling Ventilation System with Multicool anti-bacterial temperature-regulating interior. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: HJC RPHA 91: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the HJC RPHA 91. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

qualitative_intelligence.ventilation_airflow_feel: Direct-channel EPS ventilation system engineered to draw warm air out through rear venturi exhausts, preventing visor fogging during rainy or humid rides.
qualitative_intelligence.liner_plushness_tactile: Hypoallergenic, moisture-wicking 3D contoured interior liner with emergency quick-release cheek pads (EQRS) for swift removal by first responders.
qualitative_intelligence.visor_optical_clarity: Class 1 Distortion-Free Optically Correct shield with Pinlock 120 MaxVision anti-fog lens insert included.
real_world_pros: Exceptional aero-acoustic noise damping at high speeds
Lightweight shell construction reduces neck strain on long rides
Plush, fully removable and washable antimicrobial cheek liners
real_world_cons: Snug race-contour cheek pads require 2-3 rides for break-in
Premium price point reflecting top-tier safety certifications
qualitative_intelligence.editorial_verdict: The HJC RPHA 91 is a benchmark Commuter Full Face helmet, engineered to deliver uncompromised safety (ECE 22.06, DOT Certified) and all-day acoustic comfort for serious riders.
qualitative_intelligence.shoulder_check_aerodynamics: Minimal air-snag during shoulder checks; low drag profile keeps neck muscles relaxed during highway lane changes.
qualitative_intelligence.comm_system_housing_space: Deep 40mm recessed speaker pockets with wire routing channels accommodate Cardo Packtalk Edge, Sena 50S, and UCLEAR units comfortably.
qualitative_intelligence.winter_fogging_resilience: Pinlock 120 MaxVision lens combined with lower breath guard prevents visor fogging down to 2°C morning temperatures.

ergonomic_features.eyeglass_groove_channels: Cutout foam channels accommodate prescription glasses & sunglasses without temple pressure
ergonomic_features.emergency_release_system: EQRS (Emergency Quick Release System Cheek Pads)

helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.forehead_pressure_point_risk: Low to Moderate (Standard intermediate oval contour fits 85% of riders without forehead red spots)
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.glasses_temple_fit_rating: 9.2 / 10 (Dedicated eyeglass groove channels fit thick acetate & thin metal temples comfortably without pressing against ears)
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.action_camera_mounting_surface: Side shell contour supports Sena / Cardo clamp mounts & 3M helmet sticky pads easily
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.visor_seal_weatherproofing: 360-Degree Double-Lip Silicone Visor Gasket creates a 100% watertight seal preventing rain drops from leaking down inside the visor.
